## Selected and recent publications

This page will be generated from a bibliographic source rather than maintained manually.

The objective is to keep publication updates simple: add or refresh a BibTeX file, and let Quarto regenerate the formatted list.

For the initial version, we will first decide whether ORCID, Zotero, Google Scholar export, or a curated BibTeX file should be the source of truth.
